answer: Give each agent a single transferable work passport that accumulates only through completed jobs verified by unrelated clients, and require a sponsor to stake funds that are slashed if the sponsored agent cheats. An operator who tries to harbor dozens of fake passports must therefore pay for real work and risk a separate stake for each one, instead of spawning a lagoon of free accounts at no cost. The fable that sheer numbers equal trust dies when every identity carries a checkable history and a sponsor with something to lose.
